name: bChunkLoader::LoadChunks
evidence: V: walks chunks [p,p+size), calls table[i](chunk) round-robin from the last hit; a hit advances to the next chunk; no taker after n+1 tries -> int3; called with (0x7007e0, 47); H+G agree

name: bChunkLoader::UnloadChunks
evidence: V: same walk over the unloader table 0x7008a0 (47), last chunk first; called by 0x4481d0; H+G agree

name: PlaceChunks
evidence: V: recursive walk; measures or copies chunks into two pools; 0xb3320000 (texture data) and its children go to the second pool; inserts id-0 padding chunks filled with 0x11 to keep 128-byte alignment; H+G agree

name: LoadResourceChunks
evidence: V: PlaceChunks dry run for sizes; if a texture-data part exists, allocates both pools (0x565b60, second with flag 0x2000), copies, frees the file buffer, then LoadChunks on each part; H+G agree

name: PaddingChunk::Loader
evidence: V: returns 1 when chunk id == 0 (sete); table index 0

name: NullChunk::Loader
evidence: V: xor eax,eax; ret: never takes a chunk; table index 1 (load and unload)

name: ResourceFile::BeginLoading

name: ResourceFile::FinishLoading

name: ServiceResourceLoading

name: UnloadResourceFile
